temperature_range: 310 to 400 °C for one-monolayer growth, 350 to 450 °C for two-monolayer growth
summary: The study investigates the atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) of AlAs using trimethylamine-alane (TMAAl) and tris-dimethylamino-arsenic (TDMAAs). It explores the self-limiting growth mechanisms under varying TMAAl pressures and substrate temperatures, revealing the influence of surface species adsorption on growth modes. The process is characterized by one- and two-monolayer self-limiting growths, with the temperature range and precursor interactions playing critical roles in determining the growth mode.
evidence: Atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) of AlAs using trimethylamine-alane (TMAAl) and tris-dimethylamino-arsenic (TDMAAs) was studied. One- and two-monolayer self-limiting growths of AlAs were observed depending on the TMAAl pressure. The self-limiting mechanism of the ALE in the two growth modes was studied with a transient quadrupole mass spectrometry and with a temperature programmed desorption. The main factor that gives the different self-limiting growths was discussed considering the properties of the Al surfaces revealed by these measurements.
